For each combination of processing software and stage, please include the software, stage, average processing hours, average CPU and GPU usage percentages, average data size in GB, the average PER value, and the the efficiency status ('Bottleneck Detected' if it is qualified as processing bottleneck, 'Efficient' if it is not). Additionally, provide the total count of workflows for each combination. Sort the results by bottleneck status first, followed by the PER value in ascending order.

WITH flow_data AS (
  SELECT 
    sp.FlowRegistry, 
    sp.FlowSoft, 
    sp.FlowStage,
    sp.FlowHrs, 
    sp.ProcCPU, 
    sp.ProcGPU,
    COALESCE(SUM(s.GBSize), 0) AS total_gbsize,
    COALESCE(SUM(pc.TotalPts), 0) AS total_pts
  FROM ScanProcessing sp
  LEFT JOIN Scans s ON sp.ZoneRef = s.ZoneRef
  LEFT JOIN ScanPointCloud pc ON s.ArcRef = pc.ArcRef AND s.CrewRef = pc.CrewRef
  WHERE sp.FlowHrs > 0 
    AND (sp.ProcCPU + sp.ProcGPU) > 0
  GROUP BY sp.FlowRegistry, sp.FlowSoft, sp.FlowStage,
           sp.FlowHrs, sp.ProcCPU, sp.ProcGPU
),
per_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    FlowRegistry,
    FlowSoft,
    FlowStage,
    FlowHrs,
    ProcCPU,
    ProcGPU,
    total_gbsize,
    total_pts,
    CASE 
      WHEN total_pts > 0 AND total_gbsize > 0 THEN 
        (total_gbsize * log10(total_pts)) / (FlowHrs * (ProcCPU + ProcGPU) / 200.0) 
      ELSE NULL 
    END AS PER
  FROM flow_data
)
SELECT 
  FlowSoft AS software,
  FlowStage AS stage,
  AVG(FlowHrs) AS avg_processing_hours,
  AVG(ProcCPU) AS avg_cpu_usage,
  AVG(ProcGPU) AS avg_gpu_usage,
  AVG(total_gbsize) AS avg_data_size_gb,
  AVG(PER) AS avg_PER,
  COUNT(*) AS total_workflows,
  CASE 
    WHEN AVG(PER) < 0.5 THEN 'Bottleneck Detected' 
    ELSE 'Efficient' 
  END AS efficiency_status
FROM per_calc
WHERE PER IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY FlowSoft, FlowStage
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN AVG(PER) < 0.5 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
  AVG(PER) ASC;

failures.question: For each archaeological site, I need its Point Cloud Density Ratio and Feature Extraction Efficiency to identify sites with high potential for feature extraction. Please include the site code, average PCDR value, and average FEE value. Ensure that all sites are included, even if some data might be missing. Sort the results by average FEE in descending order.

WITH pcdr_raw AS (
    SELECT
        pc.ArcRef,
        pc.CrewRef,
        pc.CloudDense,
        pc.TotalPts,
        sp.AreaM2,
        CASE
            WHEN pc.CloudDense IS NOT NULL AND pc.CloudDense != 0
                 AND sp.AreaM2 IS NOT NULL AND sp.AreaM2 != 0
            THEN CAST(pc.TotalPts AS REAL) / (pc.CloudDense * sp.AreaM2)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS pcdr
    FROM scanpointcloud pc
    JOIN scanspatial sp
        ON pc.ArcRef = sp.ArcRef
        AND pc.CrewRef = sp.CrewRef
),
site_avg_pcdr AS (
    SELECT
        s.ZoneRef,
        AVG(pcdr.pcdr) AS avg_PCDR
    FROM pcdr_raw pcdr
    JOIN scans s
        ON pcdr.ArcRef = s.ArcRef
        AND pcdr.CrewRef = s.CrewRef
    WHERE pcdr.pcdr IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY s.ZoneRef
),
feature_data AS (
    SELECT
        ZoneRef,
        TraitRegistry,
        TraitCount,
        ArtiCount,
        TraitCount + ArtiCount AS sum_traits
    FROM scanfeatures
),
pointcloud_for_fee AS (
    SELECT
        s.ZoneRef,
        pcdr.pcdr,
        pcdr.CloudDense
    FROM pcdr_raw pcdr
    JOIN scans s
        ON pcdr.ArcRef = s.ArcRef
        AND pcdr.CrewRef = s.CrewRef
    WHERE pcdr.pcdr IS NOT NULL
      AND pcdr.CloudDense > 0
),
fee_by_combination AS (
    SELECT
        f.ZoneRef,
        f.sum_traits / (pf.pcdr * SQRT(pf.CloudDense)) * 1000.0 AS fee_value
    FROM feature_data f
    JOIN pointcloud_for_fee pf
        ON f.ZoneRef = pf.ZoneRef
),
site_avg_fee AS (
    SELECT
        ZoneRef,
        AVG(fee_value) AS avg_FEE
    FROM fee_by_combination
    GROUP BY ZoneRef
)
SELECT
    s.ZoneRegistry AS site_code,
    spd.avg_PCDR,
    saf.avg_FEE
FROM sites s
LEFT JOIN site_avg_pcdr spd
    ON s.ZoneRegistry = spd.ZoneRef
LEFT JOIN site_avg_fee saf
    ON s.ZoneRegistry = saf.ZoneRef
ORDER BY saf.avg_FEE DESC;
